venture.name: ClosetCue
venture.name_status: Working concept label from supplied workspace; final brand not specified
venture.concept: Camera-based wardrobe inventory connected to an app that recommends outfits using style, weather, schedule and available clothing.
venture.primary_product: Proposed camera system plus companion mobile app
venture.target_customers: Ages approximately 16-35, especially busy college students and young professionals; initially fashion- and technology-interested middle- to higher-income users of all genders.
venture.value_proposition: Save time choosing outfits, build confidence and get more use from existing clothes; distinguish clean and available items from laundry.
venture.geographic_market: Proposed United States launch, urban and suburban areas with seasonal weather; later international expansion is an aspiration.
venture.distribution_assumption: Planning hypothesis only: direct online camera-kit sales and mobile app stores; the workspace does not specify channels.
venture.features_note: Manual correction is a proposed improvement in the supplied workspace, not a validated capability.
venture.mission_statement: To make getting dressed effortless through personalized technology that saves time, builds confidence, and maximizes every wardrobe.
venture.name_note: Original venture website title; research used Smart Closet / AI Outfit Assistant working name.

assumptions: 12-month steady-state planning horizon in USD, before income tax, interest and financing.
Monthly plans: quantity means average active subscribers; revenue is price × 12 × quantity. Annual plans: quantity means full-year subscriptions; one annual payment.
Bundles and one-time products: quantity means units sold in 12 months. All bundle service is funded for 12 months per kit; no overlapping app-only subscription revenue.
Variable active-month costs charge 12 months per modeled customer or kit; change this basis for products without annual service.
Domestic online card sales assumed. App-store commissions are not included: channel policy and eligibility must be validated before launch.
No VAT/sales-tax collections, demand curve, automatic marketing-to-sales effect, inventory cash timing or customer acquisition forecast.
Startup cash is separate. Capital expenditures use explicit straight-line annual depreciation and zero salvage.
Sales mix is defined by entered quantities. Mixed-unit break-even is reported as a scale factor and product-specific quantities, not a misleading combined unit count.
Original venture site remains a student concept; features, camera reliability and customer willingness to pay are untested.
